claims.assertion: Yazhi argued that human “nuclear weapons” are energy weapons, disputing the conventional fission-chain model while acknowledging radioactive decay can release heat.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi rejected the claim that extraterrestrials first came to Earth because humans developed nuclear weapons, saying they had already been present.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said claims about intervention and nuclear testing may use misleading terminology.

claims.assertion: Yazhi speculated that some purported nuclear-explosion footage may be staged and interpreted its heat as plasma expansion or zero-point energy.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said the footage’s authenticity was uncertain.

coverage_gaps: distinctions among atomic, hydrogen, and other energy weapons
